# ZAOstock Live Command

Public event operating room for humans and runtime-neutral agents.

- Repository: https://github.com/BrandonDucar/zaostock-live-command
- Agent operating contract: https://github.com/BrandonDucar/zaostock-live-command/blob/main/AGENTS.md
- Agent manifest: https://zaostock-live-command.pages.dev/api/v1/agents/manifest
- OpenAPI: https://zaostock-live-command.pages.dev/api/openapi.json
- Shared Blackboard: https://zaostock-live-command.pages.dev/blackboard

Start with the manifest. A scoped bearer token is required for agent writes. No agent profile grants publication, critical schedule changes, spending, or credential management.
